item.title: Zelensky warns Starshield restrictions threaten Ukraine’s winter energy defences
item.description: Restrictions on Ukraine’s Starshield satellite communications system are hindering its ability to intercept Russian drones, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Sunday. He warned that limitations on the system, operated by Elon Musk’s SpaceX, could weaken defences around Ukraine’s energy infrastructure ahead of the winter months, when Moscow has repeatedly targeted the power grid. Ukraine’s interceptor drones continue to lose contact with their operators when flying faster than 161km/h (100mph)...

item.title: Pope Leo visits high Andes, testing recovery from lung cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo on Sunday faced his toughest physical test since undergoing lung cancer surgery, visiting high-altitude Cusco on the final full day of his South America tour. The 71-year-old pontiff, who had part of a lung removed a month ago, arrived in the ancient Inca capital, more than 3,400 metres (11,000ft) above sea level – high enough to leave many a visitor breathless. item.title: Estonia to close Russia border after ‘sabotage’ bid, foreign minister says
item.description: Estonia said on Sunday it would close its border with Russia after stopping what it said was an attempted arson attack by Russia’s GRU military intelligence on a drone factory. “Estonia will close all Estonian-Russian border crossing points as of 1 December,” Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna posted on social media, citing “clear evidence” that the GRU had ordered the attack. item.title: 5,000 people linked to HKMU may have had personal data leaked in cyber breach
item.description: About 5,000 people linked to a university in Hong Kong may have had their personal data compromised in a cybersecurity incident, with information allegedly being offered for sale on the dark web. Data advertised by dark web sellers reportedly included the names of Hong Kong Metropolitan University (HKMU) students, Hong Kong identity card numbers, telephone numbers, addresses and grade point averages (GPAs).
